"""Plant a repository of 200 decision records and about 20,000 commits with `git fast-import`.

usage: plant_repo.py <empty folder to make> <core-authority.yaml>
Decisions 1..100 are set ACTIVE in the first 100 commits (long ancestry walks), 101..200 at commits 10,001..10,100;
a quarter of the activating commits carry no `Role: owner` trailer. The other commits edit decision bodies; every
1,000th commit is a merge of a two-commit side branch.
"""
import datetime
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

TOTAL = 20000
base = int(datetime.datetime(2026, 10, 10, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp())
repo, declaration = Path(sys.argv[1]), Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
repo.mkdir(parents=True)
env = {"GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM": "1", "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": "/dev/null", "PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "LC_ALL": "C"}
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", "-b", "main", str(repo)], check=True, env=env)

out = []
count = 0


def commit(ref, mark, parents, message, files):
    global count
    count += 1
    body = message.encode()
    out.append(f"commit {ref}\nmark :{mark}\ncommitter T <t@t> {base + count * 60} +0000\ndata {len(body)}\n".encode())
    out.append(body + b"\n")
    if parents:
        out.append(f"from :{parents[0]}\n".encode())
        for other in parents[1:]:
            out.append(f"merge :{other}\n".encode())
    for path, text in files.items():
        data = text.encode()
        out.append(f"M 100644 inline {path}\ndata {len(data)}\n".encode() + data + b"\n")


def decision(number, status, revision):
    return (f"---\nid: DEC-{number:03d}\ntype: decision\nstatus: {status}\n---\n# DEC-{number:03d}\n"
            f"revision {revision}\n")


mark, tip = 0, None
side_edits = 0
k = 0
while k < TOTAL:
    k += 1
    mark += 1
    files = {}
    if k == 1:
        files["template/governance/kernel/checks/core-authority.yaml"] = declaration
        files["docs/README.md"] = "# planted\n"
    created = k if k <= 100 else (k - 10000 + 100 if 10000 < k <= 10100 else None)
    if created:
        files[f"docs/decisions/DEC-{created:03d}.md"] = decision(created, "ACTIVE", k)
        owner = created % 4 != 0
        message = f"decide DEC-{created:03d}\n\n" + ("Role: owner\n" if owner else "Role: engineer\n")
    else:
        number = (k * 7) % 100 + 1 if k % 3 else (k * 11) % 100 + 101
        number = number if number <= 100 or k > 10100 else number - 100
        status = "ACTIVE"
        files[f"docs/decisions/DEC-{number:03d}.md"] = decision(number, status, k)
        message = f"edit DEC-{number:03d} {k}\n\nTask: T-{k % 50}\n"
    commit("refs/heads/main", mark, [tip] if tip else [], message, files)
    tip = mark
    if k % 1000 == 0 and k < TOTAL:
        side = tip
        for _ in range(2):
            mark += 1
            side_edits += 1
            commit("refs/heads/side", mark, [side], f"side {side_edits}\n", {f"docs/side-{side_edits}.md": "x\n"})
            side = mark
        mark += 1
        commit("refs/heads/main", mark, [tip, side], f"merge side {k}\n", {})
        tip = mark

result = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "fast-import", "--quiet"], input=b"".join(out), env=env)
if result.returncode != 0:
    sys.exit(result.returncode)
subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(repo), "reset", "-q", "--hard", "main"], check=True, env=env)
print(f"planted {count} commits")
